_note: 英語島文法分區（最後一批）：不定詞/動名詞的完成式與被動式（eng.t_sub.nonfinite.perfect-passive，學測級）。完成不定詞 to have + p.p.（to have done，較早）；被動不定詞 to be + p.p.（to be done）；完成被動不定詞 to have been + p.p.（to have been done）；完成動名詞 having + p.p.（having done）；完成被動動名詞 having been + p.p.（having been done）。形式依 Swan/Cambridge，provisional，待英語母語 reviewer 複核。text-only shadowing、無音檔。

units.title_zh: 不定詞/動名詞的完成式與被動式（to have done / to have been done / having been done）
units.can_do: 我能用非限定動詞的完成式與被動式：完成不定詞 to have + 過去分詞（表較早）、被動不定詞 to be + 過去分詞、完成被動不定詞 to have been + 過去分詞，以及完成動名詞 having + 過去分詞、完成被動動名詞 having been + 過去分詞。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The perfect infinitive 'to have + past participle' shows an action that happened earlier than the main verb: 'He seems to have left already.'
claims.verification_ref: 完成不定詞 to have + 過去分詞＝比主要動詞更早（He seems to have left already）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The perfect passive infinitive is 'to have been + past participle' (earlier action + passive): 'The window seems to have been broken.'
claims.verification_ref: 完成被動不定詞＝to have been + 過去分詞（較早＋被動）：to have been broken；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The perfect gerund 'having + past participle' refers to an earlier action used as a noun: 'He denied having met her before.'
claims.verification_ref: 完成動名詞 having + 過去分詞＝較早的動作當名詞（denied having met her）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The perfect passive gerund is 'having been + past participle' (earlier action + passive): 'He was proud of having been chosen for the team.'
claims.verification_ref: 完成被動動名詞＝having been + 過去分詞（較早＋被動）：having been chosen；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: The perfect infinitive 'to have + past participle' shows an action earlier than the main verb: 'He seems to have left already.' (He left, and now he seems gone.)
teach.zh_hint: 完成不定詞 to have + 過去分詞，表示比主要動詞更早發生的事：He seems to have left already.（他似乎已經離開了。）離開在前、現在看起來不在。

teach.body: Add passive to it: the perfect passive infinitive is 'to have been + past participle' (earlier + passive): 'The window seems to have been broken.'
teach.zh_hint: 再加上被動：完成被動不定詞是 to have been + 過去分詞（較早＋被動）：The window seems to have been broken.（窗戶似乎（在之前）被打破了。）

teach.body: She seems to have lost her keys. The painting appears to have been painted long ago.
teach.zh_hint: 她似乎（之前）弄丟了鑰匙（to have lost，較早）。這幅畫看起來是很久以前（被）畫的（to have been painted，較早＋被動）。

teach.body: Gerunds do the same. The perfect gerund is 'having + past participle': 'He denied having taken the money.' The perfect passive gerund is 'having been + past participle': 'He was proud of having been chosen.'
teach.zh_hint: 動名詞也一樣。完成動名詞是 having + 過去分詞：He denied having taken the money.（他否認（之前）拿了錢。）完成被動動名詞是 having been + 過去分詞：He was proud of having been chosen.（他很自豪（之前）被選上。）

teach.body: He is believed to have left the country last week. She remembered having been praised by the teacher.
teach.zh_hint: 據信他上週已經離開這個國家（to have left，較早）。她記得（之前）被老師稱讚過（having been praised，完成被動動名詞）。

practice.stem: 選正確形式（較早發生）：She can't find her keys. She seems ____ them.（lose）

distractor_rationales.to lose: to lose 表示「和現在同時或未來」；弄丟是較早發生的，用 to have lost。
distractor_rationales.to be lost: to be lost 是被動（鑰匙被弄丟）；這裡主詞 She 是主動弄丟，用 to have lost。
distractor_rationales.losing: seem 後面接不定詞，不接動名詞 losing。

practice.feedback: 較早＋主動＝to have + 過去分詞：seems to have lost them。

practice.stem: 選正確形式（較早＋被動）：The painting appears ____ many years ago.（paint）

distractor_rationales.to be painted: to be painted 是「現在被畫」；many years ago 是較早，要用 to have been painted。
distractor_rationales.to have painted: to have painted 是主動「畫了（別的東西）」；畫是「被畫」的一方，要被動。
distractor_rationales.to paint: 缺了完成式與被動；畫作是較早被畫的。

practice.feedback: 較早＋被動＝to have been + 過去分詞：to have been painted。

practice.stem: 哪一個是動詞 do 的「完成被動不定詞」？

distractor_rationales.to have done: 這是完成不定詞（主動），不是被動。
distractor_rationales.to be done: 這是被動不定詞（沒有完成式）。
distractor_rationales.having done: 這是完成動名詞，不是不定詞。

practice.feedback: 完成被動不定詞＝to have been + 過去分詞：to have been done。

practice.stem: 哪一個是動詞 choose 的「完成被動動名詞」？

distractor_rationales.having chosen: 這是完成動名詞（主動），不是被動。
distractor_rationales.being chosen: 這是被動動名詞（沒有完成式）。
distractor_rationales.to have been chosen: 這是完成被動不定詞，不是動名詞。

practice.feedback: 完成被動動名詞＝having been + 過去分詞：having been chosen。

practice.stem: 選正確形式（較早）：He is believed ____ the country last week.（leave）

distractor_rationales.to leave: to leave 表示現在或未來；last week 是較早，用 to have left。
distractor_rationales.to be left: to be left 是被動（被留下）；這裡他是主動離開，用 to have left。
distractor_rationales.leaving: be believed 後面接不定詞，不接動名詞 leaving。

practice.feedback: 較早＋主動＝to have + 過去分詞：believed to have left last week。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀練習（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：出聲讀句子，注意 to have left、to have been painted、having been chosen 這些片語連著唸；一邊讀一邊想「這是較早、還是被動，還是兩者都有」。

lines.text: He seems to have left the office before the storm began.
She was proud of having been chosen for the national team.
